reason: Validation failed. Our Sentinel-2 MBMP detector produced candidates indistinguishable from surface-change noise: a 1.74x target-to-control ratio, and 1 same-day coincidence out of 20 opportunities against 797 independently measured plumes. Ashton (37 known plumes) scored identically to NSW bushland; Appin (35 known plumes) scored identically to empty rangeland.
note: The detector and its control harness are retained in the pipeline (matlas s2-detect) so any future version can be scored the same way. A ratio near 1.74x and one coincidence in twenty is the bar to beat.
